<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($window) {

  /* =========================================================
     GATENOW · REVIEWER RAIL · Client script

     One toggle. Every link in the rail is a real anchor with an
     href, so nothing here navigates and there is no navigation
     sink for the open-redirect scan to find — sign out
     included, which is a plain href to /logout.do.

     The pointer-tracking light and the sliding thumb are gone
     with the glass. Both needed DOM handles and geometry
     constants that had to stay in step with the stylesheet, and
     a rail that appears on every page is the wrong place to
     carry that kind of coupling.

     The collapsed state is remembered between pages. A rail
     that springs back open on every navigation is one nobody
     bothers collapsing twice.
     ========================================================= */

  var c = this;

  var KEY = 'gn.reviewerRail.tight';

  /* sessionStorage can be unavailable — private browsing, a
     hardened profile, an iframe with storage blocked — and
     touching it then throws rather than returning null, so
     every access is wrapped. A rail that will not render
     because it could not read a preference is worse than one
     that forgets it. */
  function remembered() {
    try {
      return $window.sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) === '1';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function remember(v) {
    try {
      $window.sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, v ? '1' : '0');
    } catch (e) { /* forgetting is an acceptable outcome */ }
  }

  c.tight = remembered();

  c.toggle = function() {
    c.tight = !c.tight;
    remember(c.tight);
  };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================================
   GATENOW · REVIEWER RAIL
   Service Portal widget · CSS / SCSS

   Selectors are written out in full. The Service Portal Sass
   compiler does not support parent selector concatenation.

   Matched to the applicant portal's rail: white, flush to the
   edge, grouped under quiet section labels, one accent doing
   the work.

   WHAT IS NOT HERE, ON PURPOSE

   No backdrop blur, no drifting light, no pointer-tracking
   sheen. Those depend on a compositing stack that the Service
   Portal panel wrapper interferes with, and when any part of it
   fails there is no graceful version left — only hard-edged
   blobs where a menu should be. A rail is the one component on
   every page; it has to be the most boringly reliable thing in
   the product.

   THE ACCENT

   The current page is a pale blue ground, a 3px blue edge and
   blue text and icon. Three signals for one state sounds like
   too many until you watch somebody scan a rail: the ground
   finds it peripherally, the edge anchors it, the colour
   confirms it. Everything else on the rail stays grey so those
   three can be the only colour on screen.

   TYPE
     brand      19  700  -0.02em
     group      11  600   0.09em caps
     item       15  500            → 600 when current
     count      11  600  tabular
     name       14  600
     role       12  400
   ========================================================= */

/* Service Portal wraps every widget in a panel that clips and
   pads. The rail is the full height of the page and its
   tooltips have to escape the box, so the wrapper gets out of
   the way. */
.panel,
.panel-body,
.sp-widget {
  overflow: visible !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}


/* ---------- typeface ---------- */

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_regular.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_medium.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_semibold.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_bold.woff2") format("woff2");
}


/* ---------- tokens ---------- */
$a-navy:  #0a2540;
$a-ink-2: #35455c;
$a-ink-3: #6b7a90;
$a-ink-4: #8a94a6;
$a-ink-5: #a6aebc;

$a-line:   #e6eaf1;
$a-line-2: #eef1f6;
$a-tint:   #f4f6fa;

$a-blue:    #1560e0;
$a-blue-dk: #0f4cbb;
$a-blue-1:  #eef4fe;
$a-blue-2:  #dbe7fc;

$a-stop:   #b8394a;
$a-stop-1: #fdf2f3;
$a-stop-2: #f3d8dc;

$a-white: #ffffff;
$a-ease:  cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);

$a-font: "Outfit", "Segoe UI", Roboto, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;

$r-wide:  264px;
$r-tight: 76px;


/* =========================================================
   THE RAIL
   ========================================================= */

.gnr {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: $r-wide;
  font-family: $a-font;
  transition: width 0.42s $a-ease;
}

.gnr.is-tight { width: $r-tight; }

.gnr *,
.gnr *::before,
.gnr *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

/* sticky rather than fixed: fixed takes the rail out of flow
   and the page beside it has to be padded by hand, which goes
   wrong the moment the width changes */
.gnr__inner {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  background: $a-white;
  border-right: 1px solid $a-line;
  overflow: visible;
}


/* =========================================================
   BRAND
   ========================================================= */

.gnr__brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 72px;
  padding: 0 16px 0 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $a-line-2;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gnr-mark {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  color: $a-navy;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gnr-mark:hover,
.gnr-mark:focus {
  color: $a-navy;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gnr-mark__glyph {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: $a-blue;
  color: $a-white;
  transition: transform 0.4s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-mark:hover .gnr-mark__glyph { transform: scale(1.05); }

.gnr-mark__name {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: $a-navy;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.28s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-pull {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid $a-line;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: $a-white;
  color: $a-ink-4;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.3s $a-ease, color 0.3s $a-ease,
              border-color 0.3s $a-ease, transform 0.42s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-pull:hover {
  background: $a-tint;
  border-color: $a-blue-2;
  color: $a-blue;
}

/* the chevron turns to point the way it will move the rail */
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-pull { transform: rotate(180deg); }


/* =========================================================
   NAVIGATION
   ========================================================= */

.gnr__scroll {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 20px 0 8px;
  /* visible, not auto: a scroll container clips the tooltips,
     and the nav is short enough not to need one */
  overflow: visible;
}

.gnr-group { margin-bottom: 22px; }

.gnr .gnr-group__label {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $a-ink-5;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.28s $a-ease;
}

.gnr .gnr-group__list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.gnr-item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 16px 0 20px;
  color: $a-ink-2;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.26s $a-ease, color 0.26s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-item:hover,
.gnr-item:focus {
  background: $a-tint;
  color: $a-navy;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Three signals for one state. The ground finds it
   peripherally, the edge anchors it, the colour confirms it —
   and because nothing else on the rail is coloured, those
   three are the only colour on the screen. */
.gnr-item.is-here {
  background: $a-blue-1;
  color: $a-blue;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.gnr-item.is-here:hover,
.gnr-item.is-here:focus {
  background: $a-blue-2;
  color: $a-blue-dk;
}

.gnr-item__edge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 0;
  width: 3px;
  height: 0;
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
  background: $a-blue;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  transition: height 0.3s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-item.is-here .gnr-item__edge { height: 100%; }

.gnr-item__ico {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: $a-ink-3;
  transition: color 0.26s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-item:hover .gnr-item__ico    { color: $a-ink-2; }
.gnr-item.is-here .gnr-item__ico  { color: $a-blue; }

.gnr-item__label {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.gnr-item__n {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: 22px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: $a-tint;
  color: $a-ink-3;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: center;
  transition: background 0.26s $a-ease, color 0.26s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-item__n.is-alert {
  background: $a-stop-1;
  color: $a-stop;
}

.gnr-item.is-here .gnr-item__n {
  background: $a-white;
  color: $a-blue;
}


/* =========================================================
   OVERDUE
   ========================================================= */

.gnr-alert {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  margin: 0 14px 14px;
  padding: 11px 13px;
  border: 1px solid $a-stop-2;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: $a-stop-1;
  color: $a-ink-2;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: background 0.3s $a-ease, border-color 0.3s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-alert:hover,
.gnr-alert:focus {
  background: #fbe9eb;
  border-color: #e8bfc6;
  color: $a-ink-2;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gnr-alert__ico {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: $a-stop;
}

.gnr-alert__body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.gnr-alert__n {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.006em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $a-stop;
}

.gnr-alert__label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: $a-ink-4;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}


/* =========================================================
   WHO
   ========================================================= */

.gnr__foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px 14px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid $a-line-2;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gnr-me {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 4px;
  margin: -4px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: $a-ink-2;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.3s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-me:hover,
.gnr-me:focus {
  background: $a-tint;
  color: $a-ink-2;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gnr-me__avatar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: $a-blue;
  color: $a-white;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.gnr-me__body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.gnr-me__name {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.008em;
  color: $a-navy;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.gnr-me__role {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: $a-ink-4;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.gnr-out {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: $a-ink-4;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.3s $a-ease, color 0.3s $a-ease;
}

.gnr-out:hover,
.gnr-out:focus {
  background: $a-stop-1;
  color: $a-stop;
  text-decoration: none;
}


/* =========================================================
   COLLAPSED

   Labels collapse to nothing and every row grows a tooltip.
   Nothing leaves the DOM: hiding by width and opacity keeps
   the transition smooth and keeps the labels readable to a
   screen reader.
   ========================================================= */

.gnr.is-tight .gnr__brand {
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-mark__name,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item__label,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item__n,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-alert__body,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-me__body {
  width: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-mark { justify-content: center; }

/* the pull sits under the mark rather than beside it, because
   at 76px there is no beside */
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-pull {
  position: absolute;
  top: 82px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(180deg);
  z-index: 2;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr__scroll { padding-top: 46px; }

/* the group label becomes a hairline. A four-letter
   abbreviation of "Workspace" says less than a rule does, and
   an empty gap loses the grouping altogether. */
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-group__label {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 0 20px 12px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: $a-line-2;
  color: transparent;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-me {
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-alert {
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;
  margin: 0 14px 14px;
  padding: 11px 0;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr__foot {
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 14px 0;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-me {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0;
}

/* the badge becomes a dot on the icon: the number cannot be
   read at this width, but the fact that there is one can */
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item__ico { position: relative; }

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item.has-n .gnr-item__ico::after,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item.has-alert .gnr-item__ico::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -1px;
  right: -3px;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px $a-white;
}

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item.has-n .gnr-item__ico::after     { background: $a-blue; }
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item.has-alert .gnr-item__ico::after { background: $a-stop; }

/* on the tinted active row the ring has to match that ground,
   not the card, or the dot sits in a white hole */
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item.is-here .gnr-item__ico::after {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px $a-blue-1;
}


/* ---------- tooltips ----------

   CSS rather than script. A tooltip that needs a digest to
   appear arrives late enough to be useless, and the label it
   shows is already on the element.
   ------------------------------------------------------- */

.gnr.is-tight .gnr-item,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-alert,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-me,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-out,
.gnr.is-tight .gnr-pull { position: relative; }

.gnr.is-tight [data-tip]::before {
  content: attr(data-tip);
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: calc(100% + 12px);
  z-index: 60;
  padding: 7px 11px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: $a-navy;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.7);
  color: $a-white;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate(-5px, -50%);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.2s $a-ease, transform 0.2s $a-ease;
}

.gnr.is-tight [data-tip]:hover::before,
.gnr.is-tight [data-tip]:focus-visible::before {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(0, -50%);
}

.gnr-item:focus-visible,
.gnr-me:focus-visible,
.gnr-out:focus-visible,
.gnr-mark:focus-visible,
.gnr-alert:focus-visible,
.gnr-pull:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid $a-blue;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOTION

   One short cascade on load and nothing after. A rail that is
   on every page should not perform on every page.
   ========================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {

  @keyframes gnrIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
  }

  .gnr__brand { animation: gnrIn 0.42s $a-ease backwards; }

  .gnr .gnr-group__label { animation: gnrIn 0.38s $a-ease 0.08s backwards; }

  .gnr .gnr-group__list li { animation: gnrIn 0.38s $a-ease backwards; }

  .gnr .gnr-group__list li:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.10s; }
  .gnr .gnr-group__list li:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.14s; }
  .gnr .gnr-group__list li:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.18s; }
  .gnr .gnr-group__list li:nth-child(n+4) { animation-delay: 0.22s; }

  .gnr-alert { animation: gnrIn 0.4s $a-ease 0.26s backwards; }
  .gnr__foot { animation: gnrIn 0.4s $a-ease 0.3s backwards; }
}


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE

   Below the tablet breakpoint the rail locks to icons and
   loses the collapse control. 264px of navigation on a 400px
   screen leaves no page, so the choice is not worth offering.
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  .gnr,
  .gnr.is-tight { width: $r-tight; }

  .gnr .gnr-mark__name,
  .gnr .gnr-item__label,
  .gnr .gnr-item__n,
  .gnr .gnr-alert__body,
  .gnr .gnr-me__body {
    width: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .gnr .gnr__brand {
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .gnr .gnr-mark { justify-content: center; }

  /* the pull has nothing left to do once the width is fixed */
  .gnr .gnr-pull { display: none; }

  .gnr .gnr__scroll { padding-top: 20px; }

  .gnr .gnr-group__label {
    height: 1px;
    margin: 0 20px 12px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: $a-line-2;
    color: transparent;
  }

  .gnr .gnr-item,
  .gnr .gnr-me {
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .gnr .gnr-alert {
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 11px 0;
  }

  .gnr .gnr__foot {
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 14px 0;
  }

  .gnr .gnr-me {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .gnr .gnr-item__ico { position: relative; }

  .gnr .gnr-item.has-n .gnr-item__ico::after,
  .gnr .gnr-item.has-alert .gnr-item__ico::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -1px;
    right: -3px;
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px $a-white;
  }

  .gnr .gnr-item.has-n .gnr-item__ico::after     { background: $a-blue; }
  .gnr .gnr-item.has-alert .gnr-item__ico::after { background: $a-stop; }

  .gnr .gnr-item.is-here .gnr-item__ico::after {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px $a-blue-1;
  }

  .gnr-item,
  .gnr-alert,
  .gnr-me,
  .gnr-out { position: relative; }

  .gnr [data-tip]::before {
    content: attr(data-tip);
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: calc(100% + 12px);
    z-index: 60;
    padding: 7px 11px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    background: $a-navy;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.7);
    color: $a-white;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-5px, -50%);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.2s $a-ease, transform 0.2s $a-ease;
  }

  .gnr [data-tip]:hover::before,
  .gnr [data-tip]:focus-visible::before {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(0, -50%);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .gnr,
  .gnr * {
    transition: none;
    animation: none;
  }
  .gnr-mark:hover .gnr-mark__glyph { transform: none; }

}]]></link><name>Review Sidebar</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function () {

  /* =========================================================
     GATENOW · REVIEWER RAIL
     Service Portal widget · Server script

     Navigation for the reviewer portal, plus the two counts
     worth putting on it: how much is open, and how much of that
     is late.

     Its own widget on purpose. The rail used to live inside the
     dashboard, which meant the dashboard owned navigation for
     pages it knew nothing about, and adding a page meant
     editing a widget that had no other reason to change.

     The counts use GlideAggregate rather than walking the
     table. The rail appears on every page and must not cost a
     full read of the review table each time one loads.
     ========================================================= */

  var REVIEW = 'x_enno_gatenow_grant_review';

  var me = gs.getUserID();

  function opt(name, fallback) {
    var v = options[name];
    return (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? fallback : v.toString();
  }

  function url(pageId) { return '?id=' + pageId; }


  /* ============================================================
     WHO
     ============================================================ */

  var u = gs.getUser();

  data.user = {
    name    : u.getDisplayName() || gs.getUserName(),
    title   : '',
    initials: ((u.getFirstName() || 'R').charAt(0) +
               (u.getLastName()  || '').charAt(0)).toUpperCase()
  };

  try {
    var ur = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user');
    if (ur.get(me)) data.user.title = ur.getValue('title') || '';
  } catch (e) { /* the title is decoration, not a requirement */ }


  /* ============================================================
     THE COUNTS

     Two aggregates, not a read. "Open" is anything not settled;
     "overdue" is open and past its deadline. Both are scoped to
     the groups this reviewer belongs to, so the badge matches
     what the dashboard will show them.
     ============================================================ */

  var groups = [];

  try {
    var gm = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user_grmember');
    gm.addQuery('user', me);
    gm.query();
    while (gm.next()) groups.push(gm.getValue('group'));
  } catch (e) {
    gs.warn('[ReviewerRail] group membership unreadable: ' + e.message);
  }

  /* These are the status values the review table stores. They
     are display strings rather than choice keys, which is what
     the rest of the reviewer code already assumes — if that
     changes, this list and the dashboard's tone map change
     together. */
  var SETTLED = ['Review completed', 'Declined by Reviewer'];

  var open    = 0;
  var overdue = 0;

  if (groups.length) {

    try {
      var ga = new GlideAggregate(REVIEW);
      ga.addQuery('review_group', 'IN', groups.join(','));
      ga.addQuery('status', 'NOT IN', SETTLED.join(','));
      ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
      ga.query();
      if (ga.next()) open = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0;
    } catch (e) {
      gs.info('[ReviewerRail] open count unavailable: ' + e.message);
    }

    try {
      var gd = new GlideAggregate(REVIEW);
      gd.addQuery('review_group', 'IN', groups.join(','));
      gd.addQuery('status', 'NOT IN', SETTLED.join(','));
      gd.addQuery('review_deadline', '<', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
      gd.addAggregate('COUNT');
      gd.query();
      if (gd.next()) overdue = parseInt(gd.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0;
    } catch (e) {
      gs.info('[ReviewerRail] overdue count unavailable: ' + e.message);
    }
  }

  data.overdue = overdue;


  /* ============================================================
     NAVIGATION

     Page ids come from widget options so the rail can be
     repointed without editing a script. The current page is read
     from the URL rather than passed in, so any page the rail is
     dropped on highlights itself with no extra wiring.
     ============================================================ */

  var here = '' + ($sp.getParameter('id') || '');

  var pages = {
    dashboard: opt('dashboard_page', 'review_dashboard'),
    queue    : opt('queue_page',     'review_proposals'),
    done     : opt('completed_page', 'review_completed'),
    programs : opt('programs_page',  'review_programs'),
    profile  : opt('profile_page',   'user_profile')
  };

  data.homeUrl    = url(pages.dashboard);
  data.queueUrl   = url(pages.queue);
  data.profileUrl = url(pages.profile);

  /* The icon is a semantic key, not a font class. The template
     switches on it and draws the path inline, because no icon
     font gives you a consistent 1.75 stroke across every glyph
     and inconsistent weight is what makes a rail look
     assembled rather than drawn.

     Grouped rather than flat. Four items need no grouping; six
     do, and a rail that cannot absorb its sixth item without
     becoming a list is one that gets rewritten the first time
     somebody adds a page. The group is decided here so the
     template never has to know the shape of the menu. */
  data.groups = [
    {
      key  : 'work',
      label: gs.getMessage('Workspace'),
      items: [
        {
          key  : 'dashboard',
          label: gs.getMessage('Dashboard'),
          icon : 'grid',
          url  : url(pages.dashboard),
          active: here === pages.dashboard,
          count: 0
        },
        {
          key  : 'queue',
          label: gs.getMessage('My reviews'),
          icon : 'list',
          url  : url(pages.queue),
          active: here === pages.queue,
          /* the badge carries what is open, and overdue turns it
             red rather than adding a second badge — one number
             in one place, coloured by whether it is a problem */
          count: open,
          alert: overdue > 0
        },
        {
          key  : 'done',
          label: gs.getMessage('Completed'),
          icon : 'check',
          url  : url(pages.done),
          active: here === pages.done,
          count: 0
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      key  : 'library',
      label: gs.getMessage('Library'),
      items: [
        {
          key  : 'programs',
          label: gs.getMessage('Programs'),
          icon : 'folder',
          url  : url(pages.programs),
          active: here === pages.programs,
          count: 0
        }
      ]
    }
  ];

  /* a detail page is reached from the queue, so it lights the
     queue rather than leaving the rail with nothing lit */
  if (here) {

    var lit = false;

    for (var g = 0; g < data.groups.length; g++) {
      for (var i = 0; i < data.groups[g].items.length; i++) {
        if (data.groups[g].items[i].active) { lit = true; break; }
      }
    }

    if (!lit && here.indexOf('review') !== -1) {
      for (var g2 = 0; g2 < data.groups.length; g2++) {
        for (var i2 = 0; i2 < data.groups[g2].items.length; i2++) {
          if (data.groups[g2].items[i2].key === 'queue') {
            data.groups[g2].items[i2].active = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  data.t = {
    brand     : gs.getMessage('GateNow'),
    brandSub  : gs.getMessage('Review'),
    nav       : gs.getMessage('Reviewer navigation'),
    home      : gs.getMessage('Go to the dashboard'),

    collapse  : gs.getMessage('Collapse the menu'),
    expand    : gs.getMessage('Expand the menu'),

    overdue   : gs.getMessage('overdue'),
    overdueSub: gs.getMessage('Past the review deadline'),
    role      : gs.getMessage('Reviewer'),
    logout    : gs.getMessage('Sign out')
  };

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-13 14:43:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>441658750f5b8310712b6af300d1b23c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Review Sidebar</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GateNow" source="x_enno_gatenow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="GateNow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_441658750f5b8310712b6af300d1b23c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>umar.farooq</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-13 15:12:08</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<!-- =========================================================
     GATENOW · REVIEWER RAIL
     Service Portal widget · HTML template

     Built to match the applicant portal's rail, so a person who
     is both an applicant and a reviewer sees one product rather
     than two.

     White, flush to the edge, grouped under quiet section
     labels, and one accent doing the work. No glass, no blur,
     no drifting light: those depend on a stack that the Service
     Portal panel wrapper interferes with, and when any part of
     it fails there is no graceful version of it left.

     Icons are inline SVG rather than a font. The line weight in
     the applicant rail is 1.75 and no icon font gives you that
     — Font Awesome's outline set is heavier and inconsistent
     between glyphs, which is what makes a rail look assembled
     rather than drawn.
     ========================================================= -->

<nav class="gnr" ng-class="{'is-tight': c.tight}" aria-label="{{c.data.t.nav}}">

  <div class="gnr__inner">

    <!-- ═══════════════ BRAND ═══════════════ -->
    <header class="gnr__brand">

      <a class="gnr-mark" ng-href="{{c.data.homeUrl}}" aria-label="{{c.data.t.home}}">
        <span class="gnr-mark__glyph" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="19" height="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
               stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 4v16"></path>
            <path d="M5 8h14"></path>
            <path d="M5 8l-2.5 5.5a3 3 0 0 0 5 0z"></path>
            <path d="M19 8l2.5 5.5a3 3 0 0 1-5 0z"></path>
            <path d="M8.5 20h7"></path>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <span class="gnr-mark__name">{{c.data.t.brand}}</span>
      </a>

      <button type="button" class="gnr-pull"
              ng-click="c.toggle()"
              ng-attr-aria-expanded="{{!c.tight}}"
              aria-label="{{c.tight ? c.data.t.expand : c.data.t.collapse}}"
              ng-attr-data-tip="{{c.tight ? c.data.t.expand : c.data.t.collapse}}">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
             stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"></path>
        </svg>
      </button>

    </header>


    <!-- ═══════════════ NAVIGATION ═══════════════ -->
    <div class="gnr__scroll">

      <section class="gnr-group" ng-repeat="g in c.data.groups track by g.key">

        <p class="gnr-group__label">{{g.label}}</p>

        <ul class="gnr-group__list">
          <li ng-repeat="n in g.items track by n.key">
            <a class="gnr-item"
               ng-class="{'is-here': n.active, 'has-n': n.count > 0, 'has-alert': n.alert}"
               ng-href="{{n.url}}"
               ng-attr-aria-current="{{n.active ? 'page' : undefined}}"
               ng-attr-data-tip="{{n.label}}">

              <span class="gnr-item__edge" aria-hidden="true"></span>

              <!-- one weight, one corner radius, one grid. An
                   icon set that is drawn rather than collected
                   is most of what makes a rail look finished. -->
              <span class="gnr-item__ico" ng-switch="n.icon" aria-hidden="true">

                <svg ng-switch-when="grid" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none"
                     stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <rect x="3" y="3" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="2"></rect>
                  <rect x="13.5" y="3" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="2"></rect>
                  <rect x="3" y="13.5" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="2"></rect>
                  <rect x="13.5" y="13.5" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="2"></rect>
                </svg>

                <svg ng-switch-when="list" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none"
                     stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <path d="M9 6h12"></path>
                  <path d="M9 12h12"></path>
                  <path d="M9 18h12"></path>
                  <circle cx="4" cy="6" r="1.2"></circle>
                  <circle cx="4" cy="12" r="1.2"></circle>
                  <circle cx="4" cy="18" r="1.2"></circle>
                </svg>

                <svg ng-switch-when="check" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none"
                     stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <path d="M21 11.2V19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11"></path>
                  <path d="M8.5 11.5l3 3L21 5"></path>
                </svg>

                <svg ng-switch-when="folder" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none"
                     stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <path d="M3 7.5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2 2.5h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2V18a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"></path>
                </svg>

                <svg ng-switch-default viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none"
                     stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"></circle>
                </svg>

              </span>

              <span class="gnr-item__label">{{n.label}}</span>

              <!-- a count only appears when it is not zero. A
                   badge reading 0 costs attention and returns
                   nothing. -->
              <span class="gnr-item__n"
                    ng-if="n.count"
                    ng-class="{'is-alert': n.alert}">{{n.count}}</span>

            </a>
          </li>
        </ul>

      </section>

    </div>


    <!-- ═══════════════ OVERDUE ═══════════════

         Present only when the number is not zero: a standing
         banner that is usually empty teaches people to skip the
         place it appears.
         ═══════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <a class="gnr-alert" ng-if="c.data.overdue" ng-href="{{c.data.queueUrl}}"
       ng-attr-data-tip="{{c.data.overdue}} {{c.data.t.overdue}}">

      <span class="gnr-alert__ico" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
             stroke-width="1.85" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"></circle>
          <path d="M12 7.5V12l3 1.8"></path>
        </svg>
      </span>

      <span class="gnr-alert__body">
        <span class="gnr-alert__n">{{c.data.overdue}} {{c.data.t.overdue}}</span>
        <span class="gnr-alert__label">{{c.data.t.overdueSub}}</span>
      </span>

    </a>


    <!-- ═══════════════ WHO ═══════════════ -->
    <footer class="gnr__foot">

      <a class="gnr-me" ng-href="{{c.data.profileUrl}}"
         ng-attr-data-tip="{{c.data.user.name}}">
        <span class="gnr-me__avatar">{{c.data.user.initials}}</span>
        <span class="gnr-me__body">
          <span class="gnr-me__name">{{c.data.user.name}}</span>
          <span class="gnr-me__role">{{c.data.user.title || c.data.t.role}}</span>
        </span>
      </a>

      <!-- Sign out is a real server round trip, so it is a plain
           anchor rather than anything built in script. -->
      <a class="gnr-out" href="/logout.do"
         aria-label="{{c.data.t.logout}}"
         ng-attr-data-tip="{{c.data.t.logout}}">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
             stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M15 3h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-3"></path>
          <path d="M10 17l5-5-5-5"></path>
          <path d="M15 12H3"></path>
        </svg>
      </a>

    </footer>

  </div>

</nav>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
